derivation: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and G1510 (εἰμί);
def: being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own)

occurrences.text: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
